subject: Re: Kickoff: concept bottleneck policies for auditable agents
body:
Hi Ulla,

Staffing: Quentin Farkas leads at 50%, Maren Zhou 30% on the environment wrappers and pixels pipeline, Umar Costa 25% on the concept-quality eval design. Nikhil Abebe is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 — June is the concept-eval crunch, and he owns the probe suite plus the ablation runs end to end.

Compute: titan-a100 best-effort, 24 GPUs. Multi-agent PPO with the concept loss is sample-hungry but the networks are small; the miniature cooking environments keep iteration cheap.

Sequencing note: the concept-extraction wrapper parses concept values from observation prefixes, so Maren's wrapper work gates everything — she's first in, and Quentin stubs against her interface in the meantime.

Santiago
